Non-controlling interests (“NCI”) represent the portion of equity in subsidiaries that is not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the equity
holders of the Company. NCI are presented separately within equity in the consolidated statement of financial position. Profit or loss
and each component of other comprehensive income are attributed to the owners of the Company and to the NCI, even if this results in
a deficit balance in NCI.
